paper_verdict.allowed_claim: The frozen exact-period text guard reduced meeting-level cpCER on every Eval1 and Eval2 recording under the learned source, passed both registered split gates, and transferred descriptively to the stock public source.
paper_verdict.required_caveat: The guarded learned-versus-guarded stock comparison was not statistically decisive; the result does not establish learned-front-end superiority, acoustic improvement, real-person identity, or paced end-to-end latency.
